Academic Capacity & Skills

Events & Educational Support

Empowering researchers and students through education, funding, and equal opportunities in biotechnology and computational science.

Certified Training

Professional Diploma in Chemoinformatics & CADD

Fully-subsidized 14-module interactive online diploma course.

The Educational Support program of UKABCS is designed to empower students, researchers, and institutions by providing access to academic resources, professional training, and financial aid. Access certified CADD online diplomas, Python for bioinformatics video modules, scientific audiobook libraries, and automated Google Colab analysis scripts.

Explore Diploma Course Call →
Student Research Grants

Graduation Project & Student Competition Support

Institutional support for BSc and MSc graduation research teams.

Our goal is to reduce barriers to education and research by offering scholarships, fee waivers, mentorship, and special programs. UKABCS provides direct grant funding for undergraduate and postgraduate graduation projects across partner universities in the UK and internationally, alongside software suites and travel awards.

Explore Graduation Project Grant →

Important Notice: Official Open Call Applications Only

Applications for Educational Support are only accepted during official open calls announced on this page. If there is no active call announced, applications will not be reviewed or processed. Please check regularly for updates or subscribe to our newsletter to stay informed.

Educational Services

Educational Services (Non-Financial Support)

Non-financial support that focuses on building knowledge, skills, and professional growth.

01

Training Workshops & Webinars

Practical sessions designed to build technical knowledge and hands-on skills in biotechnology, computational chemistry, and bioinformatics pipelines.

02

Free & Discounted Courses

Access to certified introductory and advanced online diploma courses at no cost or with significant subsidies to support continuous lifelong learning.

03

Mentorship Programs with Experts

One-to-one or group guidance from senior computational biologists to support postgraduate research, dissertation design, and career growth.

04

Book Club & Discussion Groups

Interactive academic forums where members engage in critical discussions about foundational reference books, cutting-edge papers, and research methods.

05

Digital Resources & Templates

A comprehensive library of ready-to-use research scripts, Google Colab notebooks, grant proposal templates, and open data archives.

06

Career Development & Internships

Expert support in scientific CV drafting, personal statement refinement, mock interviews, and priority matching with industry partner internships.

UKABCS

UK Organisation for Biotechnology and Computational Science (UKABCS) is a UK-registered non-profit academic society dedicated to peer-reviewed research, transparent grant funding, and open-access scientific education.
